svg.text: Kimi KDA K2 on NVIDIA B300: profiler-guided bottleneck diagnosis
Paired ValueSlice measurements with execution timeline, coverage–latency trend, resource ceilings, and scheduler diagnostics
GPU execution timeline: last captured iteration
Arrows denote paired measurements, not a causal fit.
Achieved throughput relative to hardware peak
Whole-GPU coverage and per-active-SM occupancy measure different layers.
Cell color encodes magnitude, not desirability.
Value slicing shortens K2 by expanding whole-GPU CTA coverage; it does not require higher per-SM occupancy.
SM and DRAM remain far below peak while scheduler no-eligible cycles stay high → issue/latency + CTA-distribution bound.
SASS: recurrence HMMA=3,640, TCGEN=0, UTCMMA=0. NCU durations are compared only within the same profiler methodology.
